description: What GPFR, the Global Pension Finding Register, is, in the caller's language, with the register page, the consent text and its version and, with a country, our fund pages. Show the consent text to the person before gpfr_register. Read only.

country.description: A country: English or native name, alias or ISO code, for example NL or Netherlands.

language.description: Optional. Default en. GPFR is live in 24 languages: en, ar, da, de, es, fa, fr, hi, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-BR, ro, ru, sv, th, tl, tr, zh. bg, uk, vi are answered in English.

name: gpfr_info
title: GPFR: what it is and the consent text
